articles.summary: Figma, Inc. (NYSE: FIG), a leading design and product development platform, today announced it will host an Investor and Analyst Session at Config 2026 on Wednesday, June 24, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time, in San Francisco, California. Config is Figma's annual user conference, bringing together over ten thousand designers, developers, and product builders shaping the future of design and product building. A live webcast of the session will be available on Figma's Investor Relations website at investor.figma.com. A replay will be available following the event.
